borders.label: 边框 1 - Border 1

borders.label: 边框 3 - Border 3
borders.description: Text Primary Light (`#37352F`): Primary body text — a warm dark gray, NOT pure black.

borders.label: 边框 5 - Border 5
borders.description: Notion's iOS app is an almost-invisible design system. The canvas is pure white (`#FFFFFF`) with barely any chrome, because Notion's philosophy is that the *content you write* is the interface. Open a page and you'll see a hero cover image (full-bleed, 120-200pt tall), a large emoji sitting just above the title, the title itself in Inter 32pt bold, and then a flow of "blocks" — paragraphs, headings, toggles, callouts, images — with no obvious framing, borders, or cards. This radical minimalism is deliberate: Notion is a blank canvas that takes on the shape of whatever the user is building (a journal, a wiki, a project tracker, a meeting note) and the UI is engineered to recede until it looks like a well-typed document.

borders.label: 边框 6 - Border 6
borders.description: The color system is muted, near-greyscale pastels. Page backgrounds can be set to nine colors (default white, gray, brown, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple, pink, red) — all desaturated and nearly paper-like (`#F1F1EF` gray, `#FAEBDD` orange, `#FBF3DB` yellow, `#EDF3EC` green, `#E7F3F8` blue, `#F6F3F9` purple, `#FAF1F5` pink, `#FDEBEC` red). These same hues (at stronger saturation) appear as callout block backgrounds, highlight chips on inline text, database tag colors, and cover images. The app has no primary CTA color — action is signaled by typography weight and position, not by a "Spotify Green" or "Gmail Red". The closest thing to an accent is links (`#2E75CC`) and the subtle Notion Black (`#000000`) on the primary "New page" button.

do: 建议：Use pure white ({#FFFFFF}) as the light canvas — Notion is paper。
建议：Use dark charcoal ({#191919}) for dark mode — NOT true black。
建议：Use warm dark text ({#37352F}) — NOT pure black。
建议：Surface block handles (⋮⋮⋮ + {+}) on long-press (mobile) or hover (desktop) — never always-visible。
建议：Use the {/} command as the primary block-creation gesture — it's the heart of Notion。
dont: 避免：use card-style borders around content blocks — Notion is flat, content flows inline。
避免：use saturated colors as page backgrounds — the 9 pastels are all near-greyscale。
避免：hard-code Inter — users can switch to Lora (serif) or IBM Plex Mono。
避免：surface block handles always — the "invisible" design is the signature。
避免：use pure black ({#000000}) for body text — {#37352F} warm dark gray is correct。
